headline: Farranac Coast Erupts as Island Clashes and Mainland Attrition Surge
war_summary: Since the previous dispatch, the western front has sharply escalated as Farranac Coast turned into a furious battleground, logging four base exchanges and thousands of fresh casualties in a sudden surge around Scythe and Mara. Peripheral island sectors remain equally unstable; Tempest Island sustained multiple rapid seizures across Blackwatch and Surge Gate, while Fishermans Row and Godcrofts both saw renewed outpost turnover following earlier lulls. On Lykos Isle, the frantic rate of base transitions recorded in prior hours has cooled to sporadic fighting, though the ground remains divided. Across the mainland interior, severe attrition continues to mount without strategic base flips. Heavy casualty rates are accelerating along the Weathered Expanse and Dead Lands fronts, matched by intense bloodletting throughout Marban Hollow, Stlican Shelf, and King's Cage. Both factions continue funneling reinforcements into these entrenched meatgrinders while contesting isolated coastal footholds.
